title: Granite AMRAP
description: 12-minute AMRAP with bodyweight goblet squat, commando push-ups and V-ups to test full endurance

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Bodyweight goblet squat
exercises.instructions: Hands in front of the chest, squat deep

exercises.name: Commando push-ups
exercises.instructions: Alternate between plank position and push-up position

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch feet

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
